honest_caveats: mean_edge is mean(model_prob - market_mid) with NO outcome in the formula — a disagreement diagnostic, not a skill claim (the PR-E lesson / 2026-06-11 audit root cause #10). Skill is the Brier pair: brier_model < brier_market = the nowcast beats the price.
One record per (market, hour-bucket): the LAST two-sided snapshot in each hour. 30s snapshots would otherwise pseudo-replicate n ~120x with near-duplicate rows.

Point-in-time discipline: each record uses only METAR obs with obs_time <= snap_time and only forecasts with as_of <= snap_time. The prior's model artifacts (router config + pickles) are static committed files, not time-versioned — near-PIT, noted honestly.

mean_after_fee_capture_usd is the realized per-contract P&L of hypothetical taker trades whose after-fee edge cleared the same 4pp gate the paper executor uses. Realized P&L legitimately carries the outcome; at small n_actionable it is mostly noise.
One-sided/crossed books are excluded (no honest mid); the skip counters keep the denominators visible.
message: No settled weather markets with orderbook history yet — normal on a fresh machine or right after pulling main. Keep the ingest cron running (`kq ingest`); once markets settle with a few hours of snapshots behind them, re-run `kq study-nowcast-edge` and this fills in.
